title: Shipday pocket capture — PRD edits & launch checks
content:
Quick morning capture (disjoint, for my eyes)

2026-03-12 AM — mood: 80% focused, 2 coffees in.

Top priorities today:
- Finalize PRD edits for hosted api throttling behavior (section 3.2) — note latency SLO language unclear.
- Follow up with SRE on canary rollback hooks & observability thresholds.
- Prep launch checklist for internal dry-run with Sales at 4pm PT.

PRD edits (short diffs / copy to paste into Confluence):
- Current wording: "If a route exceeds quota, requests will be 429'd."
  Suggested: "If a route exceeds its quota, requests will return 429 with a Retry-After header. For critical customer routes we will automatically fallback to the next-cost-tier model (see Rollout Policy)."
  Rationale: reduces user confusion and ties to fallback behavior.

- Section 3.2.1 (Batching) — add example: "For chat workloads with median seq_len <= 256 we recommend batch_size 8; for seq_len>1024 use dynamic batching with max_delay_ms=10."
  TODO: ask Bench team for exact perf numbers to cite (action: @Samir, INF-2345).

Open questions to resolve before dry-run:
- Can the dedicated routing policy be toggled per-tenant during rollout? (ask Platform Eng)
- Does the console show token-level cost in the canary view? Need to show delta compared to baseline.

Follow-ups (short list):
- Priya (SRE): confirm the exact metric name for KV cache hit rate we alert on; need threshold for auto-fallback. (slack: #sre-alerts)
- Ethan (Console): add a small widget to show canary traffic percent and current model variant; 2-day work. Prioritize for dry-run. (GH PR: linked above)
- Legal: push approval for the new data-retention blurb in PRD — I emailed legal@redwood. If no reply by EOD, escalate to Emma.

Launch dry-run checklist (internal):
[ ] 1) Canary route configured (5% traffic) — owner: Platform Eng (Samir) — check INF-2345
[ ] 2) Observability: latency p95, error-rate, KV-cache-hit displayed — owner: SRE (Priya)
[ ] 3) Auto-fallback policy tested (switch to cheaper model) — owner: Serving Runtime (Ethan)
[ ] 4) Billing delta panel visible for canary requests — owner: Console (Ethan)
[ ] 5) Docs snippet for customer-facing behavior (429 + Retry-After) drafted — owner: Product (me)
[ ] 6) Post-launch eval prompt set ready (small set of 15 prompts) — owner: Applied ML
[ ] 7) Rollback runbook verified & communicated to CS — owner: Solutions Eng

Script for 16:00 dry-run with Sales (bullet points):
- Quick intro (2m): what this launch enables (predictable latency & cost controls)
- Walk the canary (5m): route -> metrics -> fallback -> billing delta
- Demo a simulated quota exceed and show 429 + Retry-After (3m)
- Show the rollback and auto-fallback sequence (3m)
- Ask Sales to note the messaging we should give enterprise customers (5m)

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Consider adding "canary cost delta" metric as absolute $/hour not just % — easier for GTM to pitch.
- If fallback to cheaper model increases latency beyond customer SLO, we should mark the request as degraded with a response header X-Redwood-Degraded: true.
- Keep default canary window short (48h) unless high-confidence metrics.

Unresolved / blockers (short):
- Bench team perf numbers for batch config (blocks PRD final paragraph). (Samir owns)
- Legal signoff on retention copy.
- Console team needs a small API to surface canary traffic pct to the widget (Ethan says ETA 2 days).

Short call log (today):
- 09:15 sync with Samir: he will run perf matrics for batch sizes by EOD tomorrow.
- 10:30 quick with Priya: agreed to add a specific alert for kv_cache_hit_ratio < 0.6. She wants to test failover in staging today.
- 11:15 Went through PRD text with Emma (product design): moved the UX example down under 'operational behavior'.

Quick micro-tasks (for my inbox):
- publish PRD draft to Confluence with the edit notes above (tag reviewers).
- create INF ticket for Console widget (INF-2351).
- schedule 30m dry-run prep with Sales + SRE 14:00 tomorrow.

Random crumbs (notes-to-self):
- If time, sketch a simple diagram of routing tiers (low/med/high cost) for docs.
- Add one sentence in PRD about customer opt-out for fallbacks (privacy / compliance).

End of capture — not polished. Save and iterate after Priya's test.

-- maya
